name: Percy Jackson Ω
ability: Each night, choose up to four players. If at least one is nominated, learn if the others chosen that were not nominated are good or evil. You do not learn which is which.
firstNightReminder: Wake Percy Jackson and ask them to choose up to four players. Mark the chosen players with the Chosen reminder token.
otherNightReminder: Wake Percy Jackson and tell them the alignment of the non-nominated Chosen players, but do not tell Percy Jackson which alignment is for who. After, ask them to choose up to four players and mark the new chosen players with the Chosen reminder token.
flavor: “I’m the son of Poseidon and I’m gonna winnnn!”

name: Actuary Ω
ability: You start knowing 3 numbers. Once each, players may publicly guess what they mean. Each night*, learn who was closest.
otherNightReminder: If any players have made a guess, wake the Actuary. Point to the player marked *CLOSEST*.
flavor: I know the odds for many a scenario. It's just a matter of proportion.

name: Conjurer Ω
ability: Each night, choose either 2 minion or 2 demon roles. If the 1st is in play, it becomes the 2nd.
firstNightReminder: Wake and ask for 2 minion or 2 demon roles, put to sleep. If the first role is in play, wake that player and show them the "You Are" token and the 2nd role that was chosen.
otherNightReminder: Wake and ask for 2 minion or 2 demon roles, put to sleep. If the first role is in play, wake that player and show them the "You Are" token and the 2nd role that was chosen.
flavor: You come here for a healin' or for a harmin'?

name: Psychiatrist Ω
ability: Each night, pick a player. Learn whether they are under the influence of madness & from what source.
firstNightReminder: The Psychiatrist chooses a player. Either shake your head or nod and show the character inflicting the madness.
otherNightReminder: The Psychiatrist chooses a player. Either shake your head (no) or nod (yes) and show the character inflicting the madness.

name: Bellwether Ω
ability:
Each night*, if a player was executed today, learn if more good than evil
players voted for them.
otherNightReminder: If a player was executed today, count the players who voted for the execution. Nod if more good than evil players voted for them.
flavor: When the bell rings, the flock reveals which way it was led.

name: Crux Ω
ability: You start knowing a player, if they are good and executed, your team loses even if you are dead.
firstNightReminder: Point to the player marked KNOW.
flavor: You may be deceived if you trust too much, but you will live in torment if you do not trust enough.

name: Vigneron Ω
ability: Each night, one of your alive Townsfolk neighbors becomes drunk until dusk.
firstNightReminder: Make one of the Vigneron’s alive Townsfolk neighbors drunk.
otherNightReminder: The previously drunk player is no longer drunk. Make one of the Vigneron’s alive Townsfolk neighbors drunk.
flavor: Bah! My cellars are full, but I still have a whole ten bottles that need storing! I suppose I’ll just leave them in the shed until I can make space.

name: Plaguebearer Ω
ability: Each night*, if you are dead, one living Townsfolk who neighbors an Outsider might become an Outsider. [-0 to -1 Outsiders]
otherNightReminder: If the Plaguebearer is dead, a living Townsfolk who neighbours an Outsider might become an Outsider.
flavor: "Close the city gates lest the infection reach inside!"

name: Secretkeeper Ω
ability: Once per game, at night, select a player (not yourself). They learn a piece of true information. If the selected player reveals this piece of information at any point, they lose (even if you are dead).
firstNightReminder: The Secretkeeper might choose a player. If they do, tell the chosen player that the Secretkeeper has chosen them and give them one piece of true information. Then place the "Secret Given" token with the chosen player.
otherNightReminder: The Secretkeeper might choose a player. If they do, tell the chosen player that the Secretkeeper has chosen them and give them one piece of true information. Then place the "Secret Given" token with the chosen player.
flavor: I have something to share with you. Protect it as if your life depends on it. Perhaps it does.

name: Cupid Ω
ability: Each night, choose 2 players: tomorrow, the 1st player is mad that the 2nd is good, or one or both might die.
firstNightReminder: Wake the Cupid and ask them to choose 2 players. Show the first chosen player that This Character Selected You: Cupid and point to the second chosen player.
otherNightReminder: Wake the Cupid and ask them to choose 2 players. Show the first chosen player that This Character Selected You: Cupid and point to the second chosen player.

name: Cendrillion Ω
ability: You start knowing 5 in-play characters. Each night*, choose a player and guess their character. The 1st correct choice dies.
firstNightReminder: Wake them and show them 5 in-play characters.
otherNightReminder: Wake them up and ask them to choose a player and a character. If correct, mark them with the No Ability reminder token and mark the chosen player with the Dead reminder token.
flavor: "Please do not let the bells sound for midnight. That voice whispers 'Thrust the edge you hold and take away everything'."

name: Lupa Ω
ability: Each night*, 2 players die. The 1st time you die, you don't. [-? to +? Outsiders, -1 Minion]

name: Pyrotechnist Ω
ability: Each night, choose a player to bomb. Bombed players pass the bomb to anyone they target with their ability the following night. At night*, you may choose to detonate all bombed players. They die.
firstNightReminder: Wake the Pyrotechnist and prompt them to choose a player. Mark the chosen player with the “Bombed” reminder token.
otherNightReminder: Wake the Pyrotechnist, prompt them to either detonate or bomb another player. If they bomb another player, mark them with the “Bombed” reminder token. If they choose to detonate, mark all previously with the “Dead” reminder token.
flavor: Why don’t you be a dear and hold this for me, eh?

name: Shadowseeker Ω
ability: Each night* choose a player, they die. If an evil player executed an outsider (once), tonight look at the grimoire and choose a player, they turn evil. [+1 outsider]
otherNightReminder: Wake the Shadowseeker and have them pick a player. If an outsider was executed by an evil player, wake them again, show them the grimoire and have them pick a player.
flavor: Whispers on the cold wind whistle through the town. 'HE LIES IN WAIT IN HELL' is scrawled in scarlet upon the chapel doors. Citizens are scared. Children are crying. A fleeting speck of dusk falls from the church bell. Maybe he is closer than we all think.

name: Famine Ω
ability: Each night*, all players silently choose a living player. A player selected by the majority of good players dies. If you were to die this way, evil wins. All players know you are in play.
firstNightReminder: At the end of the night, announce to all players that there is a Famine in play. If there is also a Mastermind ability in play, privately wake one good player to inform them of this.
otherNightReminder: Wake everyone to prompt a choice. Clarify that this choice is for the Famine kill. Remind everyone to be silent, if needed. Tally the good votes and kill the player with the most votes. If it is tied, choose a player among the tie to kill.
flavor: That which is abundant to one is scarce to all.

name: Sin Of Lust Ω
ability: Each night*, choose a player: they are poisoned until your next choice & good players they target with their ability die. If no good alive players are chosen by dawn, deaths are arbitrary.
flavor: Look at this little cutie~ I think I'll have you get your hands dirty for me dearie

name: Thestral Ω
ability: Each night*, choose a player, they die. The first time you die, you don’t but register as dead, if the dead equal or outnumber the living then it is immediately announced whether this ability has been used.
otherNightReminder: The Thestral chooses a player and mark them the chosen player with the Dead reminder token.
flavor: "Thestrals would forcefully attack anyone or anything they saw as a threat", "Professor Rubeus Hagrid stated that they were "dead clever"." "Thestrals were carnivorous and attracted to the smell of blood."

name: Dragon Ω
ability: All players know you're the dragon. Minions and Demons do not know each other. Each day publicly choose a player: they die. After execution, players may nominate you & if executed while minions live, your team wins. [+1 Minion, -X Outsiders]
firstNightReminder: Announce the dragon to the town.
flavor: 「私の鎧は10倍の盾のようで、私の歯は剣で、私の爪は槍で、私の尾の衝撃は雷で、私の翼はハリケーンで、私の息は死です!」
